_doc: CA NH muni obligor universe at 2019-12-31 → outcomes through 2022-12-31. COVID-stress window. Universe explicitly INCLUDES obligors that defaulted/closed in 2020-2022 (CNMH, Verity SNFs, Eskaton, St. Anne's) to fight survivorship bias.
_universe_construction_methodology: Start with 14 obligors from data/ca_nh_universe.json that had outstanding 2019 muni debt. Add 7 high-signal obligors that were active in 2017-2019 but subsequently defaulted/closed/restructured: California-Nevada Methodist Homes (Ch 11 March 2021), St. Anne's Home SF (closed April 2026 but stressed 2019-2026), Eskaton (2022 covenant violation + sold 3 SNFs 2023), Verity Health subsidiary SNFs (parent in Ch 11 Aug 2018). Total ~21 obligors.
_caveats: CMS Star Ratings methodology changed April 2019 — pre-April-2019 ratings used different scoring weights. Confidence marked accordingly for any pre-April-2019 rating data.

Historical CMS Provider Info CSVs for Dec 2019 are archived but not extracted within search budget — most NH CMS fields use 'CONFIDENCE: LOW with publicly-known-direction' rather than authoritative pulls.
For obligors with publicly available stress signals at 2019 (Verity bankruptcy, CNMH operating losses, Eskaton SNF losses precursor), those are captured even where granular CMS data is not.
Eskaton, St. Anne's, and Verity SNFs would have been muni-eligible universe members at 2019-12-31 even though current 2025 universe excludes them — this is intentional anti-survivorship-bias.
